personality: 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal LIGHT fused with 3 Editorial structure (Customized: Indian Educational, Flat, Warm)
personality_one_liner: A culturally grounded, warm, and highly readable voice-interactive reading experience built on flat Indian folk-art aesthetics, completely void of western cartoon tropes.

spacing.rule: Strict 8px design grid. Avoid random spacing increments. Ensure generous tap targets (min 44pt) and child-friendly hit areas.

dont's: Strictly DO NOT use any glassmorphism, blur effects, gradients, or shadows. Keep all surfaces flat and distinct using color blocking and borders.

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Introduce the app's value, select role (Parent/Child), and handle login/OTP.

states.loading: Flat full-screen warm cream bg with a terracotta spinner.
states.error: Flat error banner at top with a solid rust red color.

screens.layout: Full-bleed illustration area taking the top half. Bottom half has large legible headings in Poppins, subtext in Nunito, and bold 20px radius buttons in Terracotta (#D85A30).

screens.name: Parent Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard for parents showing child's current progress, suggested books, and profile switching.

states.loading: Skeleton loader matching the 12px radius card shapes.
states.empty: Illustration of a child reading, inviting the parent to explore the library.
states.error: Retry block with a friendly illustration.

screens.layout: Header with greeting and child profile chip. 'Currently Reading' featured flat card. Horizontal scroll list for 'Suggested Stories'. Uses strict 8px grid and solid flat color blocks for elevation.

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: Explore available stories and upload PDFs.

states.empty: Illustration indicating no stories found for the selected filter.

screens.layout: Sticky top bar with search and pill-shaped mood/category filters in brandTertiary. 2-column grid of story cards (md radius). Floating Action Button (FAB) or prominent fixed bottom bar for 'Upload PDF' CTA.

screens.name: Story Detail
screens.purpose: Show story synopsis, preview audio events, and initiate reading.
screens.layout: Large cover image with solid color background. Synopsis text using Nunito base size. A section showing 'Audio Effects in this Story' using flat icon chips. Sticky 'Start Reading' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Reader Screen
screens.purpose: The core child experience: tracking reading aloud and triggering sounds.

states.error: Mic permission error state with clear CTA.

screens.layout: Distraction-free. Full-screen large text (Nunito 24px+). The active/current sentence is highlighted in #D85A30. Fixed bottom bar or floating pill showing mic status with a flat pulsing animation, pause/resume controls, and an event indicator chip when an audio effect triggers.

screens.name: Progress Dashboard
screens.purpose: Celebrate milestones, show reading streak, time, and words read.

states.empty: Start your first reading session to see progress.

screens.layout: Celebratory header. Grid of stat cards (12px radius, surfaceSecondary background). Simple, flat bar charts or progress rings using the Success (#3B6D11) and Primary (#D85A30) colors.

hero_story_cover.alt: Mughal painting of a royal court, representing traditional Indian storytelling

child_reading_illustration.alt: Child reading a book in warm tones

jungle_animal_illustration.alt: Indian jungle tiger representing a character in a children's story

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICTLY follow the defined color palette provided by the user. Do not introduce stray colors, gradients, neon, or any shadows.
There must be NO glassmorphism or blur effects. Use solid flat colors for elevation and hierarchy (e.g., surfaceSecondary on surface).
Use Poppins for headings and Nunito for all body/text elements. Scale must be large and child-friendly, especially on the Reader Screen.
Implement a strict 8px design grid. Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.
Card border radius is 12px (md), and primary buttons are 20px (lg).
For the Reader Screen, ensure the current sentence highlight dynamically changes the text color to #D85A30, keeping the remaining text highly readable.
Use Indian folk art inspired flat aesthetics (represented via colors and imagery choices) and avoid any western cartoon elements.
When displaying stats on the Progress Dashboard, use flat, solid-colored progress bars and rings. Do not use gradients.
Ensure high contrast and accessibility for both Light Mode (#F9F6F2) and Dark Mode (#141412).
